title: Menschie Mahj
body_html:
Menschie Mahj Mahjong Mat

Featuring original artwork by Anna Sokol, created as part of the Anna Sokol x Mahjong by SI™ artist collaboration. Crafted to order and printed in Atlanta, Georgia.

Set against a dreamy abstract painted backdrop of blues and greens, this design centers a striking pink and teal Star of David, creating a striking fusion of fine art and meaningful symbolism. A blush pink border scattered with playful dots and brushstroke flecks frames the scene in whimsical style.

Inspired by brushwork reminiscent of fine art paintings, the center panel brings depth and texture to your game table, while the surrounding pattern adds a lighthearted, celebratory touch perfect for special occasions and holiday gatherings alike.

title: Green Dragon
body_html:
Green Dragon Mahjong Mat

Bring BWILD Studios’ expressive floral style to the table with Green Dragon, created as part of the Mahjong by SI™ x BWILD Studios artist collaboration with artist and founder Bambi.

A lively hand-painted garden of daisies, berries, leafy branches, and colorful wildflowers surrounds a softly rendered grayscale floral center. Deep green and charcoal framing gives the design structure while letting the botanical artwork stay exuberant.

Green Dragon plays with contrast, pairing a vibrant outer garden with a quiet monochrome center for a layered look that feels both fresh and sophisticated.

Bambi is the artist and founder behind BWILD Studios, a surface pattern design studio known for hand-painted, lush, maximalist florals. Every design begins as an original painting in pastel, watercolor, acrylic, or oil before becoming a richly textured pattern.

Inspired by heirloom blooms from her cutting garden and travels through European wildflower fields, Kyoto gardens, and Parisian flower markets, Bambi creates expressive floral worlds filled with color, movement, and joy.

title: Existing Mat Change — Custom Mahjong Mat
body_html:
Existing Mat Graphic Design Change

Love one of our existing Mahjong by SI™ mats but want to make it a little more your own? This option is for customers who would like our design team to make graphic changes to an existing Mahjong by SI™ mat design before it is printed.

This service is intended for modifications to artwork we already offer on our website — not for creating a completely new custom mat from scratch.

Examples of Changes

  • Change colors within an existing design
  • Add a name, monogram, date, or wording
  • Add a logo or supplied graphic
  • Remove or replace an existing design element
  • Make minor layout adjustments
  • Personalize an existing mat for an event, organization, gift, or special occasion

What's Included

  • Graphic design modifications to one existing Mahjong by SI™ mat design
  • Up to two rounds of revisions
  • Final artwork prepared for printing
  • Production review for your selected mat size

How It Works

After purchasing this design service, provide the name or link of the existing Mahjong by SI™ mat you would like modified along with a clear description of the changes you are requesting.

If you are adding a logo, artwork, photograph, or other graphic, please provide the highest-quality file available.

Our design team will create your revised artwork and provide a proof for approval before the mat moves into production.

Please Note

This fee is for graphic design services only and does not include the cost of the mahjong mat. The mat must be purchased separately.

This service is for modifications to an existing Mahjong by SI™ design. If you need a completely new mat designed from scratch using your own concept, photos, branding, or inspiration, please select our full custom design service instead.

Highly detailed illustration, logo creation, photo restoration, extensive artwork reconstruction, or changes that substantially alter the original design may require an additional design fee. If your request falls outside the standard scope, we will contact you before beginning.

Design fees are nonrefundable once design work has begun.

Includes: Up to two rounds of revisions
Additional revisions: $50 per round

title: Fall Lanterns | Scallop SI Signature™ faux leather
body_html:
Fall Lanterns Mahjong Mat

Bring the warm beauty of autumn to your game table with Fall Lanterns, created from an original painting by Deb Baker of Trail East Studio as part of the Trail East Studio x Mahjong by SI artist collaboration.

This rich, painterly design celebrates the color and character of the season with decorative lanterns surrounded by layered autumn botanicals. Warm shades of orange, rust, gold, red, and green come together in a vibrant composition that feels festive, collected, and full of artistic detail.

Deb Baker’s expressive brushwork gives the lanterns and surrounding foliage a beautifully hand-painted quality, while the open playing area keeps the design functional for mahjong. The layered color and seasonal details preserve the depth and movement of Deb’s original painting, creating a mat that feels both elevated and welcoming.

Perfect for fall game nights, seasonal entertaining, Thanksgiving gatherings, gifting, or everyday play, Fall Lanterns brings warmth, color, and artistic charm to every mahjong table.

The Material

SI Signature™ faux leather features a flexible leatherette profile with a subtle grain texture and leather-look playing surface. The material is approximately 0.97 mm thick, with a soft polyester knit backing that helps protect your table.

Please note that this is intentionally a thin leatherette mat—not a thick, padded, cushioned, or neoprene-style mat. The slim profile creates a sleek, streamlined tabletop appearance, but it may not be the right material for every player. Movement may vary depending on your table surface and personal style of play.

The Finish

The wipe-clean, mold- and mildew-resistant surface is designed for easy care. Its smooth matte finish allows tiles to move across the surface without the padded or cushioned feel of neoprene.

Designed for players who prefer a thin, polished playing surface with a refined leather-look finish.

The Production

Created from an original painting by Deb Baker of Trail East Studio and produced as part of the Trail East Studio x Mahjong by SI artist collaboration.

Each SI Signature™ mat is fabricated, studio-printed, precision-cut, and finished on professional equipment in our U.S.-based studio.

Domestic production allows for faster turnaround, close quality control, and no overseas production delays.

Why You’ll Love It

  • Created from an original painting by Deb Baker of Trail East Studio
  • Created as part of the Trail East Studio x Mahjong by SI artist collaboration
  • Painterly decorative lanterns with seasonal botanical details
  • Warm autumn palette of orange, rust, gold, red, and green
  • Richly layered composition with expressive brushwork
  • Seasonal design that feels festive without being overly themed
  • Balanced 33" square format for a classic mahjong setup
  • SI Signature™ faux leather surface with a thin, streamlined profile
  • Wipe-clean and mold- and mildew-resistant
  • Subtle grain texture
  • Soft polyester knit backing for table protection
  • Smooth surface that allows tiles to move easily
  • Flexible approximately 0.97 mm leatherette construction
  • Precision-cut 33" square shape
  • Printed and finished in the USA
  • Makes an exceptional fall, Thanksgiving, or hostess gift

Details

Dimensions: 33" x 33" square
Material: SI Signature™ faux leather with soft polyester knit backing
Thickness: Approximately 0.97 mm
Profile: Thin and flexible; not padded or cushioned
Artwork: Original painting by Deb Baker of Trail East Studio
Finish: Studio-printed surface with subtle grain texture
Care: Wipe clean with a damp cloth and mild cleaning solution. Rinse with water and allow to air-dry flat.

Storage

Your mat arrives rolled in a protective plastic sleeve. After unrolling, place it flat on a clean, smooth surface and allow time for the material to relax.

Do not fold, iron, steam, or expose the mat to high heat. Because this is a thin and flexible leatherette material, the way it rests or moves may vary depending on the surface underneath it.

Please Note

This mat is made from a thin, approximately 0.97 mm leatherette material. It does not have the thickness, weight, padding, cushioning, or rubber backing of a neoprene mat. The slim leatherette profile is not for everyone.

Customers who prefer a thicker, cushioned, or more stationary playing surface may prefer one of our 3MM neoprene mats instead.

Because each mat is studio-printed, slight color variations may occur between production runs. Colors may also appear different in person due to individual screen settings, lighting, and edited photography.

Each mat is crafted to order and is final sale. No returns or exchanges are accepted.

title: Sunbeam Cabana Stripe
body_html:
Sunbeam Cabana Stripe Mahjong Mat

Bright, cheerful, and full of sunshine, the Sunbeam Cabana Stripe Mahjong Mat brings breezy resort style to your game table. This 33" scalloped design features bold yellow and crisp white vertical stripes for a fresh, graphic look that feels instantly uplifting.

The alternating bands of vivid yellow and clean white create a playful cabana-inspired rhythm with plenty of energy and personality. The scalloped edge softens the bold stripe pattern and adds a decorative finish that feels polished, playful, and intentionally styled.

Perfect for summer gatherings, poolside game nights, beach houses, hostess gifts, or anyone who loves bright color and cheerful design. Sunbeam Cabana Stripe brings a little sunshine to every mahjong table.

The Material

SI Signature™ faux leather features a flexible leatherette profile with a subtle grain texture and leather-look playing surface. The material is approximately 0.97 mm thick, with a soft polyester knit backing that helps protect your table.

Please note that this is intentionally a thin leatherette mat, not a thick, padded, cushioned, or neoprene-style mat. The slim profile creates a sleek, streamlined tabletop appearance, but it may not be the right material for every player. Movement may vary depending on your table surface and personal style of play.

The Finish

The wipe-clean, mold- and mildew-resistant surface is designed for easy care. Its smooth matte finish allows tiles to move across the surface without the padded or cushioned feel of neoprene.

Designed for players who prefer a thin, polished playing surface with a refined leather-look finish.

The Production

Designed, fabricated, printed, and finished in our U.S.-based studio. Every SI Signature™ mat is studio-printed on professional equipment and precision-cut to shape.

Domestic production allows for faster turnaround, close quality control, and no overseas production delays.

Why You’ll Love It

  • Bold yellow and crisp white cabana-inspired stripes
  • Cheerful, graphic design with bright summer energy
  • Scalloped edge adds a playful decorative finish
  • Perfect for beach houses, poolside entertaining, and colorful game rooms
  • Balanced 33" format for a classic mahjong setup
  • SI Signature™ faux leather surface with a thin, streamlined profile
  • Studio-printed original artwork, not licensed or outsourced
  • Wipe-clean and mold- and mildew-resistant
  • Subtle grain texture
  • Soft polyester knit backing for table protection
  • Smooth surface that allows tiles to move easily
  • Flexible approximately 0.97 mm leatherette construction
  • Precision-cut 33" scalloped shape
  • Printed and finished in the USA
  • Makes an exceptional hostess, summer, or housewarming gift

Details

Dimensions: 33" x 33" scalloped
Material: SI Signature™ faux leather with soft polyester knit backing
Thickness: Approximately 0.97 mm
Profile: Thin and flexible; not padded or cushioned
Finish: Studio-printed surface with subtle grain texture
Care: Wipe clean with a damp cloth and mild cleaning solution. Rinse with water and allow to air-dry flat.

Storage

Your mat arrives rolled in a protective plastic sleeve. After unrolling, place it flat on a clean, smooth surface and allow time for the material to relax.

Do not fold, iron, steam, or expose the mat to high heat. Because this is a thin and flexible leatherette material, the way it rests or moves may vary depending on the surface underneath it.

Please Note

This mat is made from a thin, approximately 0.97 mm leatherette material. It does not have the thickness, weight, padding, cushioning, or rubber backing of a neoprene mat. The slim leatherette profile is not for everyone.

Customers who prefer a thicker, cushioned, or more stationary playing surface may prefer one of our 3MM neoprene mats instead.

Because each mat is studio-printed, slight color variations may occur between production runs. Colors may also appear different in person due to individual screen settings, lighting, and edited photography.

Each mat is crafted to order and is final sale. No returns or exchanges are accepted.

body_html:

Bring the enchanting beauty of a flourishing garden to your mahjong table with the Hummingbird in Fuchsia Mahjong Mat. This vibrant scalloped design was created as part of the Trail East Studio x Mahjong by SI artist collaboration and is based on an original painting by Deb Baker.

A jewel-toned hummingbird hovers among cascading fuchsia blooms, creamy peonies, delicate ferns, and lush green foliage. The richly layered botanical border surrounds a luminous turquoise playing area, creating a design filled with color, movement, and natural beauty.

Brilliant shades of fuchsia, emerald green, turquoise, soft cream, violet, and deep blue give the artwork a joyful yet sophisticated presence. Deb Baker’s expressive painting style adds texture and personality, transforming the mat into a functional piece of tabletop art.

Perfect for garden-inspired gatherings, colorful game nights, birthdays, housewarmings, or everyday play. Hummingbird in Fuchsia makes a memorable gift for bird lovers, gardeners, art collectors, hostesses, and players who appreciate richly detailed botanical design.

The Material

SI Signature™ faux leather features a thin, flexible leatherette profile with a subtle grain texture, refined matte finish, and leather-look playing surface. The material is approximately 0.85mm thick and weighs 600 GSM, with a soft polyester knit backing that helps protect your table.

Please note that this is intentionally a thin leatherette mat, not a thick, padded, cushioned, or neoprene-style mat. The slim profile creates a sleek, streamlined tabletop appearance, but it may not be the right material for every player. Movement may vary depending on your table surface and personal style of play.

The Finish

The wipe-clean, mold- and mildew-resistant surface is designed for easy care. Its smooth matte finish allows tiles to move across the surface without the padded or cushioned feel of neoprene.

Designed for players who prefer a thin, polished playing surface with a refined leather-look finish.

The Production

Created from Deb Baker’s original painting and produced as part of the Trail East Studio x Mahjong by SI artist collaboration.

Each SI Signature™ mat is fabricated, studio-printed, precision-cut, and finished on professional equipment in our U.S.-based studio.

Domestic production allows for faster turnaround, close quality control, and no overseas production delays.

title: Gilded Jewel Estate
body_html:
Gilded Jewel Estate Mahjong Mat

Bring dramatic elegance and old-world glamour to your mahjong table with the Gilded Jewel Estate Mahjong Mat. This ornate scalloped design features layered gold scrollwork against a rich black background, accented with emerald and ruby jewel tones for a bold, luxurious finish.

Graceful baroque flourishes flow around the playing area, while deep burgundy accent lines add warmth and dimension to the elaborate frame. A soft cream center with a subtle diamond-lattice pattern balances the richly detailed border and creates a polished backdrop for your tiles.

Perfect for players who love maximalist interiors, jewel-toned color, and European estate-inspired style. Gilded Jewel Estate makes a memorable gift for milestone birthdays, elegant hostesses, holidays, or anyone who believes game night deserves a little grandeur.

The Material

SI Signature™ faux leather features a thin, flexible leatherette profile with a subtle grain texture, refined matte finish, and leather-look playing surface. The material is approximately 0.85mm thick and weighs 600 GSM, with a soft polyester knit backing that helps protect your table.

Please note that this is intentionally a thin leatherette mat—not a thick, padded, cushioned, or neoprene-style mat. The slim profile creates a sleek, streamlined tabletop appearance, but it may not be the right material for every player. Movement may vary depending on your table surface and personal style of play.

The Finish

The wipe-clean, mold- and mildew-resistant surface is designed for easy care. Its smooth matte finish allows tiles to move across the surface without the padded or cushioned feel of neoprene.

Designed for players who prefer a thin, polished playing surface with a refined leather-look finish.

The Production

Designed, fabricated, printed, and finished in our U.S.-based studio. Every SI Signature™ mat is studio-printed on professional equipment and precision-cut to shape.

Domestic production allows for faster turnaround, close quality control, and no overseas production delays.

Why You’ll Love It

  • Ornate gold scrollwork inspired by grand European estates

  • Rich black background with emerald, ruby, and burgundy accents

  • Layered baroque filigree creates a dramatic, luxurious frame

  • Soft cream center features a subtle diamond-lattice pattern

  • Scalloped edges add a distinctive, couture-inspired finish

  • Available in two sizes for game tables and smaller playing spaces

  • SI Signature™ faux leather surface with a thin, streamlined profile

  • Studio-printed original artwork—not licensed or outsourced

  • Wipe-clean and mold- and mildew-resistant

  • Subtle grain texture with a refined matte finish

  • Soft polyester knit backing for table protection

  • Smooth surface that allows tiles to move easily

  • Flexible 0.85mm leatherette construction

  • Precision-cut scalloped shape

  • Printed and finished in the USA

  • Makes an exceptional milestone, holiday, or hostess gift

Details

Available Dimensions: 20" scallop or 33" scallop
Material: SI Signature™ faux leather with soft polyester knit backing
Weight: 600 GSM
Thickness: Approximately 0.85mm
Profile: Thin and flexible; not padded or cushioned
Finish: Matte, studio-printed surface with subtle grain texture
Care: Wipe clean with a damp cloth and mild cleaning solution. Rinse with water and allow to air-dry flat.

Storage

Your mat arrives rolled in a protective plastic sleeve. After unrolling, place it flat on a clean, smooth surface and allow time for the material to relax.

Do not fold, iron, steam, or expose the mat to high heat. Because this is a thin and flexible leatherette material, the way it rests or moves may vary depending on the surface underneath it.

Please Note

This mat is made from a thin, approximately 0.85mm leatherette material. It does not have the thickness, weight, padding, cushioning, or rubber backing of a neoprene mat. The slim leatherette profile is not for everyone.

Customers who prefer a thicker, cushioned, or more stationary playing surface may prefer one of our 3MM neoprene mats instead.

Because each mat is studio-printed, slight color variations may occur between production runs. Colors may also appear different in person due to individual screen settings, lighting, and edited photography.

Each mat is crafted to order and is final sale. No returns or exchanges are accepted.

title: Winter Cardinal Wreath
body_html:
Winter Cardinal Wreath Round Mahjong Mat

Celebrate the season with the warm, nostalgic beauty of Winter Cardinal Wreath, an original holiday design created as part of the artist collaboration between Brewtifully and Mahjong by SI.

Bright red cardinals perch among poinsettias, holly berries, pine branches, and delicate winter botanicals arranged in graceful concentric circles. Coral and cream florals, sage-green foliage, playful pink ribbons, and a rich teal background create a festive palette that feels colorful, polished, and full of personality.

A subtle plaid pattern anchors the center playing area, while the surrounding wreath details bring the charm of a beautifully decorated winter garden to your table. Perfect for Christmas game nights, holiday entertaining, family gatherings, winter celebrations, or gifting to anyone who loves cardinals and beautifully styled holiday décor.

The Material

SI Signature™ faux leather features a flexible leatherette profile with a subtle grain texture and leather-look playing surface. The material is approximately 0.97 mm thick, with a soft polyester knit backing that helps protect your table.

Please note that this is intentionally a thin leatherette mat—not a thick, padded, cushioned, or neoprene-style mat. The slim profile creates a sleek, streamlined tabletop appearance, but it may not be the right material for every player. Movement may vary depending on your table surface and personal style of play.

The Finish

The wipe-clean, mold- and mildew-resistant surface is designed for easy care. Its smooth matte finish allows tiles to move across the surface without the padded or cushioned feel of neoprene.

Designed for players who prefer a thin, polished playing surface with a refined leather-look finish.

The Production

Designed, fabricated, printed, and finished in our U.S.-based studio. Every SI Signature™ mat is studio-printed on professional equipment and precision-cut to shape.

Domestic production allows for faster turnaround and close quality control without overseas production delays.

Why You’ll Love It

  • Original holiday artwork by Brewtifully

  • Created as part of the Brewtifully x Mahjong by SI artist collaboration

  • Bright red cardinals surrounded by poinsettias, holly berries, and winter greenery

  • Festive palette of teal, coral, cream, sage green, red, and soft pink

  • Playful ribbon details add movement and charm

  • Subtle plaid center creates a polished playing area

  • Balanced round composition for a beautifully styled table presentation

  • Smooth matte surface for comfortable tile movement

  • Beautiful for holiday entertaining and gifting

  • SI Signature™ faux leather surface with a thin, streamlined profile

  • Wipe-clean and mold- and mildew-resistant

  • Subtle grain texture

  • Soft polyester knit backing for table protection

  • Smooth surface that allows tiles to move easily

  • Flexible approximately 0.97 mm leatherette construction

  • Precision-cut round shape

  • Printed and finished in the USA

Details

Dimensions: 34" round
Material: SI Signature™ faux leather with soft polyester knit backing
Thickness: Approximately 0.97 mm
Profile: Thin and flexible; not padded or cushioned
Finish: Studio-printed surface with subtle grain texture
Care: Wipe clean with a damp cloth and mild cleaning solution. Rinse with water and allow to air-dry flat.

Storage

Your mat arrives rolled in a protective plastic sleeve. After unrolling, place it flat on a clean, smooth surface and allow time for the material to relax.

Do not fold, iron, steam, or expose the mat to high heat. Because this is a thin and flexible leatherette material, the way it rests or moves may vary depending on the surface underneath it.

Please Note

This mat is made from a thin, approximately 0.97 mm leatherette material. It does not have the thickness, weight, padding, cushioning, or rubber backing of a neoprene mat. The slim leatherette profile is not for everyone.

Customers who prefer a thicker, cushioned, or more stationary playing surface may prefer one of our 3MM neoprene mats instead.

title: Mahjong by SI™ Pop’s Reflection Mahjong Mat
body_html:
Pop’s Reflection Mahjong Mat

Created with love, meaning, and purpose, Pop’s Reflection brings a peaceful lake-and-mountain scene to your mahjong table. This special mat honors founder Stacie’s dad, Larry, lovingly known as Pop by his grandchildren, and is inspired by the lake at Ramah Darom, where he spent 20 summers working at a Jewish summer camp that means so much to him and his family.

The artwork features golden mountains, calm blue water, layered trees, soft reflections, and a quiet sky that feels peaceful, hopeful, and deeply personal. The scenic design captures both the beauty of the lake and the emotional weight of a place filled with memories, connection, and legacy.

This mat is part of a meaningful collaboration designed with Mahjong by SI, Bird Bam Cheer and Mahj for a Cause. In honor of Pop’s journey with Parkinson’s disease, Mahjong by SI and Mahj for a Cause are donating 10% of proceeds from this mat to the National Parkinson’s Foundation when customers use code BBC at checkout. Pop was diagnosed 16 years ago and is now in the late stages of the disease, making this design a tribute to love, resilience, family, and the places that stay with us.

Soft, symbolic, and full of heart, Pop’s Reflection is perfect for everyday play, thoughtful gifting, camp families, meaningful mahjong gatherings, and anyone who loves a mat with a story behind it. Whether you are drawn to the serene landscape, the family connection, or the cause it supports, this mat brings purpose and beauty to every round.

Crafted for both beauty and performance, the smooth neoprene surface allows tiles to glide effortlessly, while the cushioned backing enhances comfort and helps reduce noise. A stitched border ensures durability, so your mat stays polished game after game.

title: Design your Own Mahjong Mat | Custom Mahjong Mat Builder
body_html:
Design your Own Mahjong Mat | Custom Mahjong Mat Builder

Create a fully custom mahjong mat from a blank canvas. Choose from our neoprene sizes or our 33" x 33" SI Signature™ Faux Leather option. Build your own design using Canva or another design program, then upload your finished artwork before placing your order.

Need an easy way to get started? We recommend using Canva to build your artwork, add text, upload photos, logos, or graphics, and arrange everything on your mat layout. Once your design is complete, download it as a PNG file and upload it here.

Need us to design for you? No problem. Just add the design fee to your cart here.

Neoprene Production Notice: Each neoprene mahjong mat is printed using a heat-transfer process. Minor variations may occur along the edges, including slight pattern shifts, color differences or small areas of overprint. Because production batches, equipment and materials can vary, the exact color, placement and size may differ slightly from the product images or from one mat to another.

These small variations are a normal part of the neoprene printing and finishing process, do not affect the use of the mat and are not considered defects.

File Guidelines – Neoprene Style

  • For 33.5" mats, set the file size to 33.80" x 33.80".
  • Bleed is approximately 0.25". The visible area is the final mat size.
  • Please upload a 300 DPI PNG file.
  • PNG files only.
  • Low-resolution screenshots, blurry images, or images pulled from social media may not print clearly.
  • Borders should be no less than 1.75 inches wide.
  • Text and important image details should be placed at least 1.5 inches from the edge of your design.
  • Please note that 100% black, 100% red, or 100% blue placed directly next to white may create color bleeding. Avoid using fully saturated dark colors directly next to white in your design.

File Guidelines – SI Signature™ Faux Leather 33" x 33"

  • Set your artwork file to 33.75" x 33.75".
  • Please upload a 300 DPI PNG file.
  • CMYK artwork is recommended for best print preparation.
  • Extend your artwork fully through the bleed area.
  • Avoid thin borders close to the edge, as slight production variation can make narrow borders appear uneven.
  • SI Signature™ faux leather features a flexible leatherette profile with a subtle grain texture and leather-look playing surface. The material is approximately 0.97 mm thick, with a soft polyester knit backing that helps protect your table.

Custom Artwork Requirements

  • Custom artwork must be owned by the customer or properly licensed for use.
  • For custom mats using your own artwork or logo, you retain the rights to your original design.
  • We do not reproduce, resell, or add customer-submitted custom artwork to our retail collection without permission.
  • Please carefully review your completed design before uploading it. We do not send a proof because we are printing the file exactly as you provide it. Our design team will review your file for sizing, resolution, and production readiness and will contact you only if there is an issue that may affect printing or production.

A Note on AI-Generated Images

Tools such as ChatGPT and other AI image generators may create images that are too low in resolution for large-format printing. If your design was created using an AI tool, please make sure it meets the 300 DPI requirement before uploading. When in doubt, rebuild or finalize your design in Canva.

Please note: Custom mats are crafted to order and are final sale.

Polished, timeless, and beautifully refined, Koi Story brings a chinoiserie-inspired mahjong mat with refined decorative detail to your game table. Designed with illustrated artwork and a multicolor palette, this mat adds a polished, personality-filled layer to every round.

The palette gives the design a clear point of view while keeping the overall look easy to style. The design feels intentional and finished without overpowering your table, making it easy to pair with your tiles, racks, accessories, and favorite game-day setup.

Beautiful and functional, this mat is perfect for classic interiors, elegant gifting, refined game nights, and players who love decorative detail. Whether you are building a coordinated collection or choosing a standout piece for your own table, Koi Story brings a stylish finish to mahjong play.

Crafted for both beauty and performance, the smooth polyester surface allows tiles to glide effortlessly, while the cushioned Eco-friendly natural rubber backing enhances comfort and helps reduce noise. A stitched border ensures durability, so your mat stays polished game after game.


Why You’ll Love It
• Smooth polyester playing surface for effortless tile movement
• Cushioned feel for a quieter, more comfortable game
• Illustrated artwork with a multicolor palette
• Classic feel that works beautifully for styled game tables
• Beautiful choice for gifting, game nights, and everyday play
• Durable stitched edge for long-lasting quality
• Easy to roll, store, and travel with
• Printed in the USA


Details
• Dimensions: Available in 20" x 20", 31.5" x 31.5", and 33.5" x 33.5"
• Material: Polyester and Eco-friendly natural rubber with stitched border


Storage
• The mat comes rolled and packaged in a protective plastic bag for easy storage and transport. At Mahjong by SI, we want you to love your mat from the moment it arrives. Please note that the mat’s border may not lay completely flat at first, but it will typically relax and flatten with regular use.


Please Note
• Because each mat is printed, slight color variations may occur during the production process. Colors may also appear slightly different in person due to screen settings, lighting, and edited photography.
